name: First Shift
tagline: Open the lot and keep the entrance moving.
brief: Allocate arriving cars, then authorize finished stays through the exit checkpoint to free capacity.
context: A small city lot is opening for the morning. Every arrival is an ordinary compact car, but each stays for a different amount of time.
narrative: Cars arrive at the entrance over time. Your controller sees the vehicle at the head of the queue and decides where it should park. After a stay ends, the car requests permission to leave but still occupies its bay. Your rules must open the exit checkpoint before that capacity can be reused.
objective: Serve every arriving car without an allocation violation.
learningObjective: Two-sided facility control: react to arrivals, allocate capacity, and explicitly release completed resources.
intelligenceExplanation: The starter flow is empty. Add one rule for the exit checkpoint and one for the entrance queue. New rules append to the bottom and run in the order shown.
hint: Use WHEN hasExitRequest → release-vehicle, then WHEN hasWaitingVehicle → park-standard.
hints: Watch the entrance queue: its first car is the only vehicle the controller allocates this tick.
A standard car only needs the standard allocation action.
Use hasExitRequest → release-vehicle and hasWaitingVehicle → park-standard. Exit first keeps capacity turning over.

steps.label: Authorize a car through the exit checkpoint

functions.description: Assign the head vehicle to a standard space.
Authorize the oldest exit request and free its space.

objectives.label: Average entry and exit wait no more than one tick
